reason: The approximately 236.55 A^3 primitive cell, Z=1, density, and distorted-perovskite average framework are credible, and both CIFs are parseable with the stated composition. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however. The comparable whole-pattern report supplies no Rwp; the trajectory instead used a custom unweighted 8-65 degree fit whose final RMS is about 1.11 intensity units (roughly 17% of the observed-pattern RMS and well above the approximately 0.1 background noise), without validating 65-90 degrees. P1, the triclinic distortions, and the coordinates were obtained by fitting a narrowly constrained seven-coordinate realization of one Na3LaTi2Nb2O12-derived prototype, with no substantive comparison to other symmetry or framework realizations. The two submitted Ti/Nb orderings are nearly tied, so neither is individually resolved, and alternatives outside that prototype parameterization remain plausible. Physical checks establish formula, density, and absence of short contacts, but not full local chemistry: the submitted Ho environment is long and strongly underbonded (calculated bond-valence sum about 1.2 rather than 3). A scientifically motivated further attempt with a comparable whole-pattern refinement and broader symmetry/order search could materially improve the candidate set.
